title: dartrics analysis_options.yaml configuration
description: Schema for the `dartrics:` section of `analysis_options.yaml`. Drop a `# yaml-language-server: $schema=…` directive at the top of `analysis_options.yaml` to get IDE autocomplete + validation. Only the `dartrics:` key is covered; the surrounding `analyzer:` / `linter:` blocks belong to the Dart analyzer's own schema.

metrics.description: Per-metric thresholds and toggles. Each value may be a long-form map, a number (warning shorthand), or a boolean (enabled shorthand). Property names must match a built-in metric id; typos surface in-editor through the yaml-language-server (and at run time through `dartrics doctor`).

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from analysis (relative to the analysis root).

flutter.description: When true, dartrics relaxes `number-of-parameters` on widget constructors (the `key:` + callback list cultural norm). Default `true`; set `false` to force the lens on widget code.

test.description: When true, dartrics relaxes the size-and-shape lenses on files under `test/` or `integration_test/` whose basename ends in `_test.dart` (`method-length` / `source-lines-of-code` at function level; `class-length` / `number-of-methods` at class level). Default `true`; set `false` to apply production-grade thresholds to test files too.

snapshot.description: Snapshot mode — controls the per-file sha256 cache used to power diff-mode reports.

enabled.description: Override the metric's default-on / default-off state.

roots.description: File-scoped reachability roots in `<path suffix>::<scope>` form, for declarations a framework invokes by naming convention. The path matches as a `/`-boundary suffix of the analysed file path; the scope is the dotted name the `signals:` block uses (`topLevelFn` or `Type.member`). Supplying this key replaces the default list.

filter.description: Narrows the reported declaration kinds. Empty means every kind.

path.description: Optional override for the snapshot file path. Resolved relative to the analysis root.

warnStale.description: Surface dismissals that never matched a live violation in the analyzed file set. Reports the stale entries via stderr WARNING and a `staleDismissals:` block on the AI / JSON reports.

yamlPath.description: Override for the YAML sidecar path (default: `dartrics-dismissals.yaml`).
